Responsabilidades Técnicas


Desarrollo Frontend


• Frameworks: dominio sólido de Angular con TypeScript; capacidad de evaluar y definir cuándo usar React según el proyecto.

• Gestión de Estado: criterio para elegir y diseñar la estrategia de estado a nivel de aplicación (Redux, Context API, NgRx, servicios inyectados), no solo usarla.

• Consumo de Servicios: diseño de la capa de comunicación con el backend (interceptores, manejo centralizado de errores, refresh de tokens, estrategias de caching en cliente).

• Maquetado y Estilo: definición de sistemas de componentes reutilizables y librerías internas (Tailwind CSS o Bootstrap como base), con criterio de diseño escalable para múltiples equipos.

Desarrollo Backend

• Arquitectura de APIs: dominio experto de ASP.NET Core Web API, middleware custom, filtros, versionado de APIs y diseño de contratos (REST/GraphQL).

• Patrones de Arquitectura: dominio de Clean Architecture, DDD (Domain-Driven Design) y CQRS; capacidad de decidir qué patrón aplicar según el problema, no solo implementarlo.

• Manejo de Datos Pro: dominio avanzado de Entity Framework Core (Migrations, Shadow Properties, optimización de consultas, resolución de N+1) y criterio para saber cuándo bajar a SQL puro o Dapper por performance.

• Seguridad: diseño de esquemas de autenticación/autorización (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect), gestión de CORS y validación de datos (FluentValidation) a nivel de arquitectura, no solo de implementación.

• Asincronismo y Concurrencia: uso avanzado de async/await, manejo de background jobs (Hangfire, Quartz), y resolución de problemas de concurrencia y bloqueos en sistemas de alta carga.


Arquitectura y Sistemas Distribuidos


• Liderar el diseño de arquitecturas escalables, mantenibles y desacopladas para múltiples equipos de desarrollo.

• Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de microservicios: definición de bounded contexts, comunicación entre servicios (síncrona y asíncrona), patrones de resiliencia (circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead).

• Sistemas de mensajería y eventos: diseño de flujos con Kafka, RabbitMQ o Redis (pub/sub, colas, event sourcing cuando aplique).

• Definir el stack tecnológico del equipo y los estándares de arquitectura, documentando decisiones (ADRs) y trade-offs.

• Realizar code reviews con foco en arquitectura y deuda técnica, no solo en estilo de código.

DevOps y Calidad

• Diseñar y mantener pipelines de CI/CD, incluyendo estrategias de despliegue (blue-green, canary). • Acordar la estrategia de testing del equipo (unitarios, integración, end-to-end) y los criterios de cobertura.

• Diseñar la infraestructura de despliegue en entornos cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), con foco en escalabilidad y costos.

• Implementar observabilidad: logging estructurado, métricas, tracing distribuido, alertas proactivas ante degradación de performance.

Herramientas de desarrollo y Colaboración

• GitHub, GitLab (incluyendo definición de branching strategy)

• Postman

• Visual Studio Code / Visual Studio

• Docker y orquestación (Kubernetes deseable)

• SQL Server Management Studio, DBeaver

• APIs REST y GraphQL


Competencias Técnicas — Nivel Esperado


• Capacidad para liderar el diseño técnico de features y proyectos completos, no solo ejecutarlos. • Experiencia resolviendo problemas de performance y escalabilidad en sistemas productivos de alto tráfico.

• Dominio profundo de patrones de arquitectura, con criterio para elegir el patrón correcto según el contexto del negocio.

• Habilidad para diseñar esquemas de base de datos eficientes a nivel de sistema (no solo de una feature), considerando particionamiento y escalabilidad.

• Capacidad de detectar y resolver deuda técnica de forma proactiva.


Competencias Blandas Requeridas


Liderazgo Técnico y Trabajo en Equipo


• Liderazgo Técnico: guiar decisiones de arquitectura y stack, y ser referente técnico para el equipo.

• Comunicación Técnica: explicar trade-offs y decisiones técnicas complejas tanto a perfiles técnicos como no técnicos (negocio, PM).

• Mentoría: formar y acompañar a desarrolladores semi senior y junior de forma estructurada (pairing, revisiones de diseño).

• Colaboración: articular con múltiples equipos y stakeholders en proyectos cross-funcionales. • Adaptabilidad: manejar ambigüedad y cambios de prioridades en proyectos de mayor escala.

Mentalidad Ágil y Ownership

• Orientación a Resultados: balancear entrega de valor continuo con sostenibilidad técnica a mediano/largo plazo.

• Mejora Continua: impulsar mejoras de procesos y arquitectura a nivel de equipo, no solo de código propio. • Propiedad: responsabilidad end-to-end sobre sistemas completos, incluyendo su operación en producción. • Curiosidad: evaluar y proponer adopción de nuevas tecnologías con criterio de negocio.


Requisitos de Experiencia


Formación y Experiencia


• 9+ años de experiencia en desarrollo full stack, con al menos 3 años en roles de mayor responsabilidad técnica.

• Experiencia comprobable liderando el diseño de arquitecturas para proyectos de alta complejidad. • Experiencia mentoreando o liderando técnicamente a otros desarrolladores.

• Portfolio o ejemplos de código/arquitectura para revisar.

Deseables

• Experiencia con serverless architectures.

• Experiencia con sistemas de mensajería (Kafka/RabbitMQ/Redis) en producción. • Titulación universitaria en Sistemas o campos relacionados.

• Certificaciones cloud (Huawei/AWS) deseables.


Cómo postular

Enviar CV (y opcionalmente, repositorios o ejemplos de trabajo) a:

📩 rrhh@encodesa.com.ar

Título del puesto: Responsable de Intendencia y Compras No Productivas

Tipo de empleo: Relación de dependencia (full time)

Modalidad de trabajo: Presencial — Córdoba Capital, Argentina

Nuestro cliente está buscando un Responsable de Intendencia y Compras No Productivas. Si tenés experiencia en intendencia y mantenimiento edilicio, compras indirectas, Excel avanzado y manejo de ERP (Odoo), esta oportunidad es para vos.

Nuestro cliente es una compañía internacional radicada en Córdoba con más de tres décadas de trayectoria, con operaciones que abastecen a toda Latinoamérica. Focalizada en indumentaria y complementos deportivos, integra licencias oficiales de primera línea y marcas propias. La posición resulta fundamental para garantizar la continuidad de la operación, el orden y la eficiencia en servicios, insumos e infraestructura.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestionar integralmente el funcionamiento, conservación y seguridad de las instalaciones (depósito/centro de distribución y oficinas administrativas).
  • Identificar fallas eléctricas, de plomería, albañilería, climatización, cerrajería y estructura general; coordinar reparaciones con especialistas y evaluar diagnósticos e informes técnicos.
  • Coordinar y auditar servicios generales: limpieza, recolección de residuos, seguridad e higiene y mantenimiento de espacios comunes.
  • Gestionar la compra y el stock de insumos operativos del depósito (cajas, cintas, film stretch, etiquetas, pallets, zunchos, bolsas, etc.), evitando quiebres que frenen armado y despacho.
  • Ejecutar el ciclo completo de compras no productivas (oficina, limpieza, cafetería, herramientas, indumentaria, insumos informáticos, mantenimiento de equipamiento logístico y activos fijos).
  • Analizar, evaluar y negociar precios, plazos de pago, garantías y tiempos de entrega, considerando costo y viabilidad técnica.
  • Emitir, hacer seguimiento y registrar solicitudes, presupuestos y órdenes de compra en el ERP (Odoo).
  • Controlar vencimientos y gestionar el pago en tiempo y forma de servicios públicos (luz, agua, gas, conectividad/internet) e impuestos/tasas inmobiliarias y municipales.
  • Auditar facturas de proveedores y contratistas contra presupuestos aprobados y coordinar el ingreso al circuito de pago con Administración y Finanzas.
  • Monitorear consumo de insumos y gastos de mantenimiento/servicios; desarrollar KPIs (ahorros, desvíos, nivel de servicio) y elaborar reportes y proyecciones para Dirección.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia mínima de 2 a 3 años en funciones combinadas de intendencia/mantenimiento/servicios generales y compras no productivas (excluyente).
  • Conocimientos prácticos de mantenimiento edilicio (electricidad, albañilería, plomería, pintura, cerrajería) para evaluar presupuestos técnicos.
  • Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, análisis de datos) (excluyente).
  • Experiencia de gestión con ERP, idealmente Odoo.
  • Manejo de Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Gmail) (deseable).
  • Inglés intermedio.
  • Formación deseada (no excluyente): estudiante avanzado o formación universitaria en Administración, Logística, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

Beneficios

  • Club La Voz.
  • Descuentos en mercadería.
  • Snacks saludables diarios.

¡Esperamos tu postulación para conocerte pronto! ¡Muchas gracias!

Aviso importante: Si aplicás, revisá tu email con frecuencia durante las próximas 24 a 48 horas, ya que vamos a mantenerte al tanto por ese medio.

About /slantis

Join a rapid growth company working in the US market distributed between 3 offices. Learn and work with the best team ever!


Role Overview

As a role focused on achieving outcomes, the Project Manager's responsibilities are adaptable and dynamic, potentially undergoing significant changes to align with company, team, and project objectives. Emphasizing action, the primary goal is to drive progress and coordinate efforts to enhance outcomes. Balancing priorities among company requirements, client expectations, project needs, and team dynamics, the Project Manager plays a crucial role in team leadership. They must lead by example, embody organizational values and culture, and contribute to achieving company objectives.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and oversee all project-related activities from start to finish, ensuring timely delivery and within budget.
  • Develop and maintain the project schedule, identifying key milestones and assigning resources to meet established deadlines.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and resources to optimize project efficiency and productivity.
  • Act as the main point of contact between the client and the project team, ensuring clear and effective communication to understand and meet client needs.
  • Manage the project budget, monitor costs, and ensure efficient use of financial resources.
  • Identify and proactively resolve project issues and risks, implementing effective solutions to mitigate any negative impacts on the final outcome.
  • Supervise the quality of work performed, ensuring it meets client standards and requirements, as well as relevant regulations and standards.
  • Collaborate with the Project Architect to ensure successful and seamless project execution.


Competencies & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture
  • Previous work experience developing projects for the US is a must.
  • +5 years of experience in architectural design and technical development in construction projects in a BIM environment.
  • Strong team development and leadership skills
  • ONLY Advanced/Native English speakers will be considered.
  • Profound knowledge and experience in using BIM software, such as Revit, ArchiCAD, or others.
  • In-depth working knowledge in construction with emphasis on production work in a team environment and project setup required.
  • Enthusiastic, team player, and quick learner
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborate with different teams and disciplines.


The Perks of Being a /slanter

  • Relational reward, meaningful, challenging work, and self-development with mentoring.
  • Formal and informal learning opportunities, conferences, and resources.
  • Flexibility and work-life balance policies.
  • /slantis on tour, on-site client support, and traveling between our offices opportunities.
  • The Slanter experience, lunch-and-learn, your birthday, and company gatherings.


Our Values

  • We bring people to our team who care about our mission to revolutionize the AEC industry through technology, and who feel aligned with our values:


  • Innovation- New and better ways to do things.
  • Extra Care- Extra mile!
  • Make it happen- You work hard and you ship it, we're doers.
  • Collaboration- Impossible alone, possible together


The /slantis culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. We are committed to building and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone.

descriptionHtml:
Imagine being part of a team that’s redefining the future of mobility—where your ideas don’t just sit in a lab but power next-generation technology. At indie, we are developing cutting-edge semiconductors, photonics, and radar sensors and systems for automotive, industrial, and adjacent markets. Our innovations are at the heart of advanced intelligent sensing and user experience applications, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

If you're passionate about groundbreaking technology and want to make a real impact alongside a fast-paced team that thrives on creativity and collaboration, we’d love to have you on board!

The Functional Safety Engineer (FSE) at indie plays a key role within our design organization and is central to our automotive safety culture. In this position, the FSE leads and advocates for the functional safety lifecycle across projects, ensuring our designs and processes meet all relevant automotive safety standards.

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze top-level safety requirements and safety goals at the stakeholder level
  • Develop technical safety concepts and technical safety requirements for products
  • Work with the System Architect to refine system architecture and detailed safety mechanism descriptions
  • Derive hardware (HW) and software (SW) safety requirements from technical safety requirements
  • Collaborate with design teams to define effective technical solutions that achieve system, HW, and SW robustness in compliance with functional safety standards
  • Create safety analysis work products (System FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, etc.)
  • Monitor safety verification and validation activities
  • Support customer inquiries and reviews related to functional safety topics and work products
  • Cooperate with the Functional Safety Manager (FSM), global FuSa teams, and external contractors as needed
  • Support design engineering with impact analysis of design changes and ensure continued functional safety compliance
  • Support internal and external safety assessment reviews

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry (e.g., design, test, or quality); highly motivated and capable early-career candidates are also encouraged to apply
  • BS or MS in Natural Sciences, Applied Physics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering
  • Strong manufacturing, quality engineering, and data analysis skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Reliable, detail-oriented, and customer-focused mindset with strong documentation skills
  • Strong understanding of ISO 26262 and automotive engineering principles
  • Experience creating safety documents (Safety Concepts, FMEA, FMEDA, DFA, FTA)

Qualifications

  • Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., JAMA)
  • Knowledge of product development lifecycles for systems, electrical, or software development
  • Strong technical leadership, planning, and organizational skills
  • ISO 26262 certification is a plus
  • Experience with safety analysis tools (e.g., Medini) is a plus
  • Self-motivated with the ability to develop creative solutions
  • Familiarity with automotive standards (e.g., IATF 16949, VDA 6.3) is a plus
  • Ability to travel internationally as required

indie Semiconductor and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

Concerning agencies: indie Semiconductor does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for fees related to such.

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a QA Automation Engineer (Playwright & AI).

  • You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience with QA automation.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
  • Has designed, built, and maintained automated test suites in production using Playwright.
  • Has integrated AI tools or frameworks (e.g., GitHub Copilot, test generation tools, or LLM APIs) into a production QA workflow.
  • Has owned automated end-to-end (E2E) and regression test suites for web applications.
  • Well-versed in defect tracking, bug lifecycle management, and core software QA methodologies.
  • Proficient in automated testing principles for web platforms.
  • Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
  • Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

  • Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.
  • Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
  • FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

Desde PORTA acompañamos a INTELMEC INGENIERIA en la búsqueda de Chofer Operador de Camión con Hidrogrúa para incorporarse a importantes proyectos de montaje e infraestructura industrial.

Buscamos personas con experiencia en la posición, que cuenten con conocimientos en:

  • Conducción y traslado de cargas industriales: Operación y manejo de camiones para el traslado seguro de materiales y equipos, asegurando la correcta sujeción y verificación de las condiciones de transporte.
  • Operación de hidrogrúa y maniobras de izaje: Dominio en la operación de hidrogrúas de acuerdo con el diagrama de carga del equipo y la planificación técnica de cada maniobra en planta o campo.
  • Verificación técnica previa y elementos de maniobra: Capacidad para evaluar pesos, alcance de carga, condiciones del terreno, estabilizadores e inspección de accesorios de izaje (eslingas, grilletes, fajas, entre otros).
  • Coordinación de maniobras y comunicación en obra: Trabajo articulado con el señalero, supervisor y personal de obra para establecer áreas de trabajo seguras y el correcto código de señales.
  • Mantenimiento preventivo e inspecciones: Realización de controles e inspecciones previas al uso, registro de traslados y reporte oportuno de fallas o requerimientos de mantenimiento del vehículo e hidrogrúa.
  • Criterio de seguridad y normativas aplicables: Conocimiento de regulaciones de tránsito y normas de seguridad en maniobras de izaje, trabajando bajo estrictos estándares para garantizar la prevención de accidentes en obras industriales.
  • Trabajo en equipo y compromiso con la calidad: Disposición para coordinar acciones de manera colaborativa con los responsables de obra y logística.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia comprobable de al menos 3 años conduciendo camiones y operando hidrogrúas.
  • Licencia de conducir habilitante vigente acorde al porte del camión y al tipo de operación.
  • Capacitación o certificación comprobable en operación de hidrogrúas y maniobras de izaje.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar en obras e itinerar/realizar viajes según necesidades de los proyectos.

Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en obras industriales, traslado de equipos pesados y conocimientos básicos de mecánica e hidráulica.

Ofrecemos

  • Incorporación inmediata a proyectos de gran envergadura.
  • Buen clima de trabajo.
  • Posibilidades de desarrollo profesional.

descriptionHtml:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

  • Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
  • Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
  • Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
  • Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
  • Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
  • Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

  • Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.
  • Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.
  • Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.
  • Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.
  • Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.
  • Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

  • Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.
  • Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.
  • Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.
  • Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.
  • Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.
  • Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).
  • 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.
  • Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.
  • Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.
  • Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.
  • Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.
  • Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.
  • Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.
  • Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
  • Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
  • A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
  • Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.
  • Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
  • Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

  • Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.
  • Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.
  • Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).
  • Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.
  • Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.
  • Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.
  • Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.
  • FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay.
  • 100% remote work.
  • The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
  • Continuing education opportunities.
  • Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

About Us

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact

The Role

Proofpoint Engineering is looking for a Senior Program Manager to drive delivery across our cybersecurity product portfolio. In this role, you'll lead cross-functional programs that span Engineering, Product, Threat Research, and Operations — ensuring teams stay aligned, dependencies are managed, and critical products ship on time to protect millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do

  • Coordinar la resolución de incidentes de infraestructura, conectividad y comunicaciones.

  • Experiencia previa en Infraestructura IT y Networking.
  • Experiencia en coordinación de equipos y/o liderazgo de proyectos tecnológicos.
  • Experiencia administrando servidores Windows y/o Linux.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de:
  • Active Directory, DNS y DHCP.
  • TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing y Switching.
  • Wi-Fi empresarial, VPN y Firewalls.
  • Experiencia en diagnóstico y resolución de incidentes.
  • Conocimientos de seguridad informática y gestión de accesos.
  • Curso CCNA aprobado o en curso – excluyente.

  • Certificación CCNA.
  • Experiencia administrando infraestructura de múltiples sucursales o sitios.
  • Experiencia con Cisco, MikroTik, Fortinet, Ubiquiti u otras tecnologías de networking.
  • Conocimientos de VMware o Hyper-V.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de monitoreo, backup y recuperación.
  • Gestión de proveedores y presupuesto.
  • Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace.

🎓 Formación

Estudiantes avanzados/as o graduados/as de Ingeniería en Sistemas, Licenciatura en Sistemas, Analista de Sistemas, Tecnicaturas en Redes/Infraestructura o carreras afines.

Buscamos una persona

Proactiva, resolutiva y organizada, con capacidad de liderazgo, planificación, toma de decisiones y coordinación de equipos. Orientada a la continuidad operativa, al servicio interno y a la mejora continua.

🎮 Si te apasiona la infraestructura, el networking y el liderazgo, y querés formar parte de una empresa donde la tecnología hace posible la diversión, te estamos buscando.

About ID90 Travel

Did you know that one of the privileges of working for an airline is being able to fly around the world for free? Well, we at ID90 Travel provide the technology that makes that airline employee travel possible for the world's leading airlines. We've also become the leading one-stop comprehensive solution for airline employee travel needs. This includes providing them with exclusive rates on hotels, cruises, rental cars and more.

Job Description

We seek a curious, proactive, and technically capable Semi-Senior QA Software Engineer with strong foundations in exploratory testing and hands-on use of AI-assisted Quality Engineering tools. We value people who question assumptions, investigate defects, and steadily expand their technical independence.

The initial focus is our Hotels product, testing features, business scenarios, and integrations. Over time, the role may support Frontend Engineering, existing automation, and backup QA coverage across teams, with responsibilities expanding as product knowledge and experience grow. We value selecting the right testing technique rather than labeling work as exclusively manual or automated.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Engineering & Integration

  • Design and execute functional, exploratory, integration, and regression tests for web and mobile applications, using agreed risk priorities.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and defects; communicate progress and blockers promptly.
  • Test REST APIs and backend behavior; investigate frontend/backend issues using developer tools, logs, network requests, and API responses, seeking guidance on complex problems.
  • Participate in cross-team end-to-end testing and help identify what can be validated before full frontend integration.

AI-Augmented Quality Engineering

  • Apply AI assistants in everyday testing to explore test ideas, investigate defects, understand technical behavior, and support small automation tasks.
  • Critically check AI-generated outputs, protect confidential information, and share practical AI-assisted learnings.

Automation, Collaboration & Adaptability

  • Execute and troubleshoot existing automated tests; make small updates with guidance and collaborate with the QA Automation team.
  • Build Hotels and Frontend knowledge, improve testing practices and documentation, and provide backup coverage in areas where appropriately trained.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Software QA, including hands-on functional and exploratory testing of web applications.
  • Practical API testing experience (e.g., Postman) and understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, and client-server basics.Ability to reproduce and investigate defects using developer tools, logs, network requests, and API responses; familiarity with risk-based test design.
  • Ability to execute and diagnose existing automated tests, with willingness to make small changes with support.
  • Demonstrated hands-on use of generative AI in testing or technical tasks, including critical validation of results and responsible data handling.
  • Clear communication, collaboration, willingness to learn, and intermediate-to-advanced written and spoken English.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Playwright, Cypress, or automated API/integration testing.
  • AI coding assistants, reusable AI-assisted workflows, or emerging agent-based tools.
  • SQL, mobile testing, CI/CD tools, Jira, and test management systems.
  • Familiarity with frontend architecture or experience in travel, hospitality, e-commerce, or transactional platforms.

What Success Looks Like

Become a dependable contributor to Hotels testing: independently validate well-defined features, explore meaningful edge cases, test APIs, and escalate risks and dependencies early. With support on complex integrations, grow toward contributing to automation, AI-assisted improvements, cross-team testing, and backup coverage for familiar product areas.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on travel technology used by airline employees around the world.
  • Collaborate with experienced Engineering, Product, and QA professionals.
  • Contribute to meaningful improvements in software quality and delivery practices.
  • Build experience across frontend, backend, integration testing, and AI-assisted engineering.
  • Join a collaborative environment that values curiosity, continuous learning, and shared responsibility for quality.
  • Have the opportunity to extend the engagement or potentially transition into a long-term position with ID90 Travel.

descriptionHtml:
Turn interest into bookings—and keep players coming back

Community Sports Partners operates sports and recreation businesses. We are looking for someone who combines strong email and SMS marketing skills with sales follow-through and organized day-to-day coordination.

Your work will connect three things: campaigns that generate interest, conversations that turn interest into bookings, and pickup games that run smoothly enough for people to return. You will help sell available sports facility time and permit-backed bookings, support pickup-game operations remotely, and build email and SMS campaigns that increase participation and repeat business.

What You Will Own

Email and SMS marketing

  • Plan, write, build and send campaigns promoting available facility time, pickup games, registration opportunities and relevant offers
  • Create useful segments by location, sport, expressed interest, booking history and engagement
  • Build and improve welcome messages, lead follow-up, incomplete-booking recovery where supported, reminders, repeat-booking and win-back flows
  • Write clear English copy with specific offers and calls to action. Adapt existing brand assets into mobile-friendly emails
  • Check audiences, dates, time zones, prices, links, personalization and suppression rules before launch
  • Monitor delivery failures, bounces, complaints and opt-outs; maintain consent records and healthy lists
  • Test messaging, timing, offers and journeys, then report qualified enquiries, paid bookings, repeat participation and revenue alongside engagement metrics

Permit and facility-time sales

  • Maintain an accurate view of available locations, dates, time slots, capacity and approved pricing
  • Respond to enquiries from teams, coaches, leagues, organizers and other customers looking for sports space
  • Understand what customers need, recommend suitable availability, prepare approved quotes and follow up through booking and payment confirmation
  • Keep the sales pipeline current, document customer commitments and pursue renewals or repeat bookings
  • Coordinate with the operations team before promising availability or exceptions. Escalate pricing, terms and conflicts outside your authority

Pickup-game coordination

  • Create and maintain accurate game listings, including location, start time, capacity, pricing and player instructions
  • Monitor registrations and fill levels; use targeted outreach to help fill available places
  • Coordinate with local hosts and venue contacts, making sure each game has the information and support it needs
  • Manage routine player questions and waitlists, and communicate approved changes promptly
  • Identify low-enrolment games, host gaps or venue problems early and escalate cancellation, refund or safety decisions to the appropriate manager
  • Track attendance, feedback and repeat participation, and use what you learn to improve future games

This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome. Please apply once using your preferred location listing.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • Practical experience building email campaigns and automations, plus hands-on SMS experience
  • Strong written and spoken English for North American customer conversations
  • Confidence following up with leads, explaining an offer and asking for the booking
  • Strong attention to detail with schedules, prices, customer records and competing deadlines
  • Experience with a CRM and an email/SMS platform; examples include Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Mailchimp or comparable tools. Experience with every platform is not required
  • Comfort using spreadsheets and reports to understand conversion, bookings and campaign performance
  • Dependable communication and willingness to own the next action until an issue is resolved
  • Availability to work evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time is required. This is when most games and customer activity take place, so these shifts are a core part of the role. The specific weekly schedule will be agreed before hiring

Experience in sports, venue bookings, inside sales, event coordination, customer service or ecommerce retention is helpful. You should enjoy both campaign execution and customer follow-through.

What Success Looks Like

In the first month, learn the inventory, customer journeys and operating processes; audit existing campaigns and establish a reliable follow-up and QA routine.

Over the following two months, take ownership of the campaign calendar and sales pipeline, improve priority automations, and make pickup-game coordination dependable. We will agree measurable goals for paid bookings, use of available facility time, game fill rates, repeat participation and service quality after reviewing the baseline.

Apply with your resume and answer the questions in this application. Remove customer data and confidential employer information from examples. Applicants throughout Latin America are welcome; the selected location is a recruitment location, not a residence requirement.

Required Assessments

Please complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners with that email, indicate this in the application.

  • Culture Index survey
  • Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits

Remote from Latin America. Monthly base of US$800-US$1,000 based on experience, plus expected variable commissions of US$500-US$1,000. Expected total US$1,300-US$2,000 per month. Commissions depend on performance and are not guaranteed. Evening and weekend work in Toronto/Eastern time is required, when most games and customer activity take place. The specific weekly schedule and commission terms will be agreed before hiring.

descriptionHtml:
Buscamos un/a Analista de Calidad para sumarse a nuestro equipo y contribuir al cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad e inocuidad de nuestros procesos productivos. La posición tendrá un rol clave en la gestión, auditoría y mejora continua de los programas de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM), Procedimientos Operativos Estandarizados de Saneamiento (POES) y Manejo Integrado de Plagas (MIP).

Principales responsabilidades

Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM)

  • Realizar auditorías internas en los distintos sectores productivos.
  • Elaborar informes e indicadores de desempeño de BPM.
  • Gestionar desvíos mediante propuestas de mejora y acciones correctivas.
  • Evaluar y definir requisitos de BPM para nuevos proyectos y mejoras edilicias.


POES e Higiene

  • Diseñar, actualizar y validar procedimientos de saneamiento.
  • Verificar el cumplimiento de los procesos de limpieza mediante auditorías e inspecciones.
  • Realizar monitoreos ambientales y controles de superficies.
  • Gestionar desvíos, proponiendo acciones correctivas y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Mantener actualizados los indicadores de higiene y saneamiento.


Manejo Integrado de Plagas (MIP)

  • Coordinar y controlar la gestión de la empresa tercerizada de control de plagas.
  • Analizar tendencias y gestionar desvíos detectados.


Capacitación

  • Desarrollar e implementar el plan anual de capacitación en BPM, POES y MIP.
  • Promover la cultura de calidad e inocuidad en toda la organización.


Requisitos

  • Se requiere formación universitaria o tecnicatura universitaria en: Licenciatura en Tecnología de los Alimentos, Ingeniería en Alimentos, Ingeniería Química, Tecnicatura Universitaria en Química, Tecnicatura en Alimentos.
  • Experiencia previa de al menos 2 años en posiciones similares
  • Conocimientos de BPM, POES, MIP y sistemas de gestión de calidad e inocuidad alimentaria.


Valoraremos especialmente

  • Capacidad de análisis y seguimiento de indicadores.
  • Orientación a la mejora continua.
  • Habilidades de comunicación y capacitación.
  • Proactividad, organización y autonomía.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en equipo e interactuar con diferentes áreas productivas.

Talan – Positive Innovation

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

  • Data & Technologies: We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Cloud & Application Services: We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
  • Management & Innovation Consulting: We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.



Job Description

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst / Power BI Developer with strong experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business dashboards and reports using Power BI. The successful candidate will join an Agile squad and play a key role in transforming business requirements into data-driven reporting solutions that support decision-making across the organization.

The professional will work closely with business stakeholders, taking ownership of assigned user stories, building reports and dashboards, validating data quality, and supporting end users during the final validation process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business and technical requirements from assigned user stories.
  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Create and optimize data models, measures, and visualizations.
  • Validate data quality, consistency, and accuracy across reporting solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and investigate data-related issues.
  • Collaborate with business users and technical teams to ensure reporting requirements are met.
  • Support end users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and final data validation activities.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Document reporting solutions, business rules, and technical developments.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience with Power BI.
  • Experience building enterprise-level dashboards and reports.
  • Strong data analysis and data validation skills.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Intermediate knowledge of PL/SQL.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into reporting solutions.
  • Experience interacting with business stakeholders and supporting final report validation.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • B2B or employment contract
  • Remote within CET Time zone.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !

About Us

En CNH, nos impulsa un propósito claro: servimos e impulsamos a las personas que alimentan y construyen un mundo en crecimiento.

Como líder global en agricultura y construcción, desarrollamos equipos, tecnologías y soluciones que ayudan a nuestros clientes a trabajar de manera más productiva y sostenible. Nuestro éxito comienza con nuestra gente, y promovemos una cultura colaborativa donde la innovación prospera y cada persona tiene la oportunidad de crecer.

Grow a Career. Build a Future.

Si estás listo para generar impacto y construir una carrera con propósito, hay un lugar para vos en CNH.

Sé parte de esta empresa líder en agricultura y construcción, que innova con pasión para impulsar la eficiencia y el éxito de nuestros clientes. Y sabemos que la innovación no ocurre sin colaboración. Por eso, todo lo que hacemos en CNH Industrial tiene como objetivo alcanzar nuevas metas como un solo equipo, siempre entregando lo mejor para nuestros clientes.

Job Purpose

Key Responsibilities

  • Dar soporte en la coordinación de programas de capacitación para Team Leaders, Supervisores y Gerentes.
  • Colaborar con distintas áreas de Manufactura, Recursos Humanos y Finanzas, interactuando con colaboradores y líderes de diferentes niveles.
  • Realizar seguimiento de la Matriz de Versatilidad en planta, brindando apoyo a los líderes en el uso de la herramienta.
  • Monitorear el avance de los entrenamientos en MTA's, acompañando el seguimiento de indicadores y resultados.
  • Colaborar en el relevamiento y actualización de competencias de los distintos niveles de Manufactura.
  • Crear y difundir comunicaciones y materiales para apoyar iniciativas de capacitación y mejora continua.
  • Brindar soporte a los programas de involucramiento de operadores mediante propuestas Kaizen, realizando seguimiento de las iniciativas presentadas.
  • Colaborar en la compra y coordinación de reconocimientos para programas de involucramiento.
  • Dar soporte en la organización de eventos, campañas y actividades del área de Mejora Continua.
  • Actuar como punto de apoyo en el uso de la plataforma MLean, acompañando a las áreas en su implementación y utilización.

Experience Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ser alumno regular de Ingeniería Industrial o afines.
  • Ser estudiantes universitarios con al menos 1 año y medio restante de carrera al momento de iniciar la pasantía.
  • Contar con movilidad para asistir a la planta los 5 días de la semana (no llegan colectivos a la zona).
  • Idioma inglés nivel intermedio-avanzado.
  • Proactividad y ganas de aprender.
  • Manejo avanzado de Excel.

Pay Transparency

What We Offer

Ofrecemos oportunidades de carrera dinámicas en un entorno internacional. Como empleador que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades, estamos comprometidos con generar valor para todos nuestros empleados y fomentar una cultura de respeto.

En CNH, Entendemos Que Las Mejores Soluciones Surgen De Las Experiencias y Habilidades Diversas De Nuestra Gente. Acá Vas a Tener El Poder De Desarrollar Tu Carrera, Seguir Tu Pasión y Ayudar a Construir Un Futuro Mejor. Algunos De Nuestros Beneficios Son

  • Asignación estímulo competitiva
  • Almuerzo bonificado
  • Medicina prepaga, entre otros.

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

DiDi es la plataforma de tecnología de movilidad más grande del mundo. Con más de 10 años en el mercado, somos la empresa líder en servicios basados en aplicaciones para transporte inteligente, entrega de alimentos y servicios de pago. Haciendo la vida mejor y más fácil para las personas todos los días.

Cuando te unes a Didi, vas a formar parte de una comunidad abierta, inclusiva y diversa de más de 12,000 empleados en todo el mundo. Desde el primer día encontrará una rica cultura global colaborativa donde sus responsabilidades tendrán un impacto directo en la estrategia y el crecimiento de la empresa.

About The Team/role

Como Especialista en Desarrollo de Franquicias, serás responsable de impulsar la expansión y el desarrollo de nuestra red de socios franquiciados en Argentina.

Tu misión será identificar, atraer, cerrar y desarrollar socios estratégicos que nos permitan expandir nuestra operación y garantizar un suministro de movilidad robusto y de alta calidad.

Serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo de vida completo del socio, desde la prospección y negociación, pasando por el onboarding y lanzamiento de la operación, hasta su crecimiento, desarrollo y optimización de desempeño.

Buscamos un perfil comercial y estratégico, con capacidad para abrir nuevas oportunidades y construir relaciones de largo plazo con nuestros socios, ayudándolos a desarrollar y escalar sus operaciones de manera sostenible.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Búsqueda Estratégica y Adquisición (Hunting): Identificarás y prospectarás activamente nuevos socios potenciales, asegurando que cumplan con el perfil necesario para la operación.
  • Gestión del Ciclo de Vida del Socio: Liderarás el proceso de punta a punta, desde el onboarding hasta la evaluación mensual de desempeño y, de ser necesario, la ejecución de procesos de salida (Eliminación) basados en el ranking de rendimiento.
  • Maximizando el crecimiento (Farming): Actuarás como un consultor de negocios para tus socios, ayudándoles a escalar sus operaciones de "0 a 100", ajustando sus estructuras de costos y optimizando sus estrategias de reclutamiento.
  • Análisis y Optimización Operativa: Utilizarás herramientas de datos para monitorear métricas críticas, interviniendo en casos de comportamientos anormales.
  • Búsqueda Estratégica (Hunting): Identificarás y prospectarás nuevos socios potenciales, asegurando que cumplan con el perfil que se acople a la opreción.
  • Implementación de Incentivos: Diseñarás y supervisarás la aplicación de fórmulas de reparto de bonos.
  • Mentoría y Liderazgo: Aunque no tiene reportes directos, se espera que actúe como un referente para el equipo, conectando los puntos entre la estrategia de la organización y la ejecución en campo.


We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Seniority Estratégica: 4 años o más de trayectoria en roles de ventas, gestión de cuentas clave (KAM) o desarrollo de negocios, preferiblemente en sectores de movilidad, logística o plataformas tecnológicas.
  • Perfil Hunter-Farmer Comprobado: Capacidad demostrada para abrir mercados y cerrar alianzas estratégicas desde cero, con la disciplina necesaria para gestionar y escalar esas cuentas a través de un coaching basado en datos.
  • Capacidad de Priorización: Excelente juicio para manejar prioridades a corto plazo, alineando el trabajo individual con los objetivos de la organización.
  • Dominio Analítico: Capacidad para interpretar tableros de control complejos y convertir KPIs en planes de acción comerciales.
  • Comunicación Profesional: Capacidad para presentar hallazgos técnicos de manera clara y profesional a audiencias senior, ganando su confianza a través de datos sólidos.
  • Excelencia en Ejecución y Detalle: Enfoque meticuloso en los procesos de dispersión de utilidades y cumplimiento de contratos para mitigar riesgos operativos.
  • Idiomas: Español nativo. Inglés básico es un "Nice-to-Have" (deseable), pero no es obligatorio.


You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

  • Location: Anywhere in LATAM
  • Work Model: 100% Remote
  • Engagement: Full-time Contractor
  • Project: Cybersecurity / Identity & Endpoint Security
  • Seniority: Principal
  • English Level: B2 / C1


Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build digital products with heart.

We are a Latin American technology company partnering with organizations around the world to create high-impact software products and engineering solutions. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, continuous learning, and long-term relationships.

We work with distributed teams and technically challenging projects where engineering quality, ownership, and real business impact matter.


About the Project

We’re partnering with a U.S.-based cybersecurity company specializing in Identity Assurance, passwordless authentication, and enterprise endpoint security.


The company develops security products designed to help organizations protect user identities, devices, and access to critical systems while reducing the risks associated with passwords, phishing, compromised credentials, and unauthorized access.


Its technology operates in complex enterprise environments where authentication, identity verification, endpoint security, and reliability are business-critical.


The platform leverages modern authentication standards and technologies such as FIDO2, WebAuthn, passkeys, cryptography, and phishing-resistant authentication, helping organizations strengthen how users securely access corporate applications and infrastructure.


From an engineering perspective, the company builds software that integrates deeply with operating systems such as macOS and Windows, including components related to authentication, credential management, system security, privileged operations, and endpoint protection.


These solutions are designed to operate reliably across large fleets of enterprise devices, creating complex engineering challenges around operating system internals, security frameworks, permissions, software distribution, system upgrades, compatibility, performance, debugging, and secure communication.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal macOS Systems & Security Engineer to join this highly technical cybersecurity project.


This is not a traditional macOS application development role.

The position is focused on building software that operates much closer to the operating system, integrating deeply with native macOS capabilities and security mechanisms.


You’ll work on system-level and security-sensitive components related to authentication, identity, privileged operations, inter-process communication, credential management, and enterprise endpoint protection.


As a Principal Engineer, you’ll operate as a highly experienced individual contributor, taking ownership of complex technical problems, influencing architecture, defining engineering standards, and collaborating closely with Engineering, Security, Product, and other technical stakeholders.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and evolve low-level software components running on macOS.
  • Develop security-sensitive functionality related to authentication, identity, and endpoint protection.
  • Work with native macOS frameworks and system technologies.
  • Build and maintain privileged services and background processes.
  • Design secure communication between application-level and privileged system components.
  • Work with technologies such as XPC, Launch Agents, Launch Daemons, Keychain, and Authorization Services.
  • Contribute to macOS System Extensions and endpoint security capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain software using Swift, Objective-C, C, and C++, depending on the component and technical requirements.
  • Build authentication and credential-management capabilities.
  • Work with technologies and protocols such as FIDO2, WebAuthn, passkeys, PAM, and CryptoTokenKit.
  • Apply secure coding practices and cryptographic principles when implementing authentication and identity workflows.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues using logs, diagnostic tooling, debugging, and system-level analysis.
  • Investigate difficult operating system issues where documentation or established solutions may be limited.
  • Ensure reliability and compatibility across different macOS versions and enterprise environments.
  • Contribute to software packaging, installation, upgrades, permissions, code signing, and entitlements.
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams on secure communication using APIs and networking protocols.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and long-term technical decisions.
  • Research new Apple APIs, operating system changes, and security frameworks.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.
  • Help define engineering standards and best practices for macOS platform development.


What You Bring

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, ideally 10+ years, with significant exposure to macOS or systems-level software development.
  • Deep understanding of macOS internals, operating system behavior, processes, permissions, services, and security architecture.
  • Strong programming experience with Swift and/or Objective-C.
  • Solid experience with C and/or C++.
  • Experience building software that goes beyond the traditional application layer.
  • Strong understanding of systems programming concepts.
  • Experience with inter-process communication and privileged operations.
  • Hands-on knowledge of macOS technologies such as:
  • XPC
  • Launch Agents
  • Launch Daemons
  • Keychain Services
  • Authorization Services
  • Experience troubleshooting complex system-level software.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, identity, and credential management concepts.
  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, and TCP communication.
  • Understanding of applied cryptography and secure software development principles.
  • Experience developing reliable software deployed across enterprise environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities.
  • Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems.
  • Experience making architectural and technical design decisions.
  • Strong ownership and autonomy.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with the Apple Endpoint Security Framework.
  • Experience developing System Extensions.
  • Knowledge of CryptoTokenKit.
  • Experience with PAM modules.
  • Experience with FIDO2, WebAuthn, or Passkeys.
  • Background in passwordless authentication or Identity Security products.
  • Experience with endpoint security, EDR, IAM, device management, or enterprise security software.
  • Knowledge of applied cryptography, including concepts such as:
  • RSA
  • Elliptic Curve Cryptography
  • Diffie-Hellman
  • AES
  • Experience with certificate management.
  • Experience with enterprise macOS environments.
  • Knowledge of macOS installers and software distribution.
  • Experience with code signing, entitlements, permissions, and privileged components.
  • Experience supporting software deployed across large fleets of corporate devices.
  • Experience modernizing Objective-C codebases toward Swift.
  • Previous experience working as a Principal, Staff, or Lead-level Individual Contributor.


Why This Role Is Different

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working below the traditional application layer and solving complex problems involving operating systems, security, authentication, identity, and enterprise endpoints.

Rather than focusing primarily on UI or consumer applications, you’ll be working on security-critical software deeply integrated into macOS.

It’s a strong fit for professionals coming from environments such as:

  • Endpoint Security
  • EDR
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Passwordless Authentication
  • Device Management
  • Enterprise Security Software
  • Systems Engineering
  • macOS Platform Engineering


What Darwoft Offers

  • Contractor agreement with payment in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Argentina’s public holidays
  • English classes
  • Referral program
  • Access to learning platforms

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and stay long enough to make it survive contact with production.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are diagnosing why retrieval quality collapsed after a data refresh. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is data, retrieval, and model behavior: you make agents trustworthy by getting the data, context, and evaluation right.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

  • Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.
  • Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.
  • Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.
  • Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. Talan – Positive Innovation

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

  • Data & Technologies: We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Cloud & Application Services: We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.
  • Management & Innovation Consulting: We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.



Job Description

We are looking for a Control-M Functional Analyst to join an international team responsible for managing and supporting business-critical batch processes and operational workflows.

This role is primarily functional rather than development-focused. We are seeking a professional with strong Control-M expertise, solid SQL knowledge, and excellent communication skills who can act as the bridge between business users and technical teams.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable gathering requirements, coordinating and executing tests, analyzing incidents, and ensuring the successful delivery of functional solutions. Deep development expertise is not required; however, basic knowledge of Python and automation concepts will be considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, manage, and track processes executed through Control-M.
  • Coordinate and execute functional testing activities, ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between business users and technical teams.
  • Analyze functional incidents, coordinate investigations, and follow up on issue resolution.
  • Provide operational support and validate deliverables before production releases.
  • Coordinate activities related to enhancements, changes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Gather and understand business requirements, translating them into functional solutions.
  • Ensure proper documentation of processes, test cases, and operational procedures.
  • Support users during testing and implementation phases.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience working with Control-M in functional, operational, or support environments.
  • Experience coordinating and executing functional testing activities.
  • Strong understanding of batch processing, scheduling, and workflow monitoring.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL Server and SQL querying.
  • Basic knowledge of Python programming.
  • Experience working directly with business users and technical teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • English: B2 minimum

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • B2B or employment contract
  • Remote within CET Time zone.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !

Talan Spain’s commitment to non-discrimination based on gender, race, ideology, or any other reason, in accordance with the company’s "Equality Plan" and the current regulations on gender equality between women and men (Royal Decree-Law 6/2019).

Work model: Hybrid – Córdoba, Argentina

Equipment: Company-provided Apple laptop

Contract duration: Initial 12-month contract, with the possibility of transitioning to an indefinite-term contract upon completion of the initial period, subject to business needs, performance, and mutual agreement.

About ID90 Travel

Did you know that one of the privileges of working for an airline is being able to fly around the world for free? Well, we at ID90 Travel provide the technology that makes that airline employee travel possible for the world's leading airlines. We've also become the leading one-stop comprehensive solution for airline employee travel needs. This includes providing them with exclusive rates on hotels, cruises, rental cars and more.

Job Description

We seek a curious, proactive, and technically capable Semi-Senior QA Software Engineer with strong foundations in exploratory testing and hands-on use of AI-assisted Quality Engineering tools. We value people who question assumptions, investigate defects, and steadily expand their technical independence.

The initial focus is our Hotels product, testing features, business scenarios, and integrations. Over time, the role may support Frontend Engineering, existing automation, and backup QA coverage across teams, with responsibilities expanding as product knowledge and experience grow. We value selecting the right testing technique rather than labeling work as exclusively manual or automated.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Engineering & Integration

  • Design and execute functional, exploratory, integration, and regression tests for web and mobile applications, using agreed risk priorities.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and defects; communicate progress and blockers promptly.
  • Test REST APIs and backend behavior; investigate frontend/backend issues using developer tools, logs, network requests, and API responses, seeking guidance on complex problems.
  • Participate in cross-team end-to-end testing and help identify what can be validated before full frontend integration.

AI-Augmented Quality Engineering

  • Apply AI assistants in everyday testing to explore test ideas, investigate defects, understand technical behavior, and support small automation tasks.
  • Critically check AI-generated outputs, protect confidential information, and share practical AI-assisted learnings.

Automation, Collaboration & Adaptability

  • Execute and troubleshoot existing automated tests; make small updates with guidance and collaborate with the QA Automation team.
  • Build Hotels and Frontend knowledge, improve testing practices and documentation, and provide backup coverage in areas where appropriately trained.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Software QA, including hands-on functional and exploratory testing of web applications.
  • Practical API testing experience (e.g., Postman) and understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, and client-server basics.Ability to reproduce and investigate defects using developer tools, logs, network requests, and API responses; familiarity with risk-based test design.
  • Ability to execute and diagnose existing automated tests, with willingness to make small changes with support.
  • Demonstrated hands-on use of generative AI in testing or technical tasks, including critical validation of results and responsible data handling.
  • Clear communication, collaboration, willingness to learn, and intermediate-to-advanced written and spoken English.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Playwright, Cypress, or automated API/integration testing.
  • AI coding assistants, reusable AI-assisted workflows, or emerging agent-based tools.
  • SQL, mobile testing, CI/CD tools, Jira, and test management systems.
  • Familiarity with frontend architecture or experience in travel, hospitality, e-commerce, or transactional platforms.

What Success Looks Like

Become a dependable contributor to Hotels testing: independently validate well-defined features, explore meaningful edge cases, test APIs, and escalate risks and dependencies early. With support on complex integrations, grow toward contributing to automation, AI-assisted improvements, cross-team testing, and backup coverage for familiar product areas.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on travel technology used by airline employees around the world.
  • Collaborate with experienced Engineering, Product, and QA professionals.
  • Contribute to meaningful improvements in software quality and delivery practices.
  • Build experience across frontend, backend, integration testing, and AI-assisted engineering.
  • Join a collaborative environment that values curiosity, continuous learning, and shared responsibility for quality.
  • Have the opportunity to extend the engagement or potentially transition into a long-term position with ID90 Travel.
